app.name: Overpass
app.intro: Overpass gathers integration sheets for African mobile payment, SMS and USSD APIs, sorted by service, country and stack. Each sheet gives the code that works, the known traps and the date of the last try. A test track simulates the operators without a merchant account, and an MCP server serves the sheets to your code assistant.
